{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute total revenue per channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum().reset_index()

total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values('revenue', ascending=False)

# Extract the top channel
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['channel']
best_revenue = total_revenue_by_channel.iloc[0]['revenue']

print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel}')
print(f'Total revenue: {best_revenue}')"}
